quest.title: They Call Him Raptor
quest.description: During the exam, you were mistaken for the thief Raptor by Otto, a Knight of Favonius, and were stopped. After clearing the misunderstanding, you volunteer to help arrest Raptor — and so begins the chase.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Mora x6175, Adventurer's Experience x3, Fine Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Track Raptor
Talk to Amber

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: This is Springvale. There must be some clues about Raptor 'round here.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: The Sister from the Cathedral put some secret Anemo markings on the artifact he took.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> and keep your eyes peeled for clues.

talks.objective: Look for clues to track Raptor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... How do we know if this was left by Raptor or an Anemo Slime?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Anemo Slimes are airborne creatures. They don't leave marks on the ground, unless someone stomped on one to take-off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Are you telling me people actually do that?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Either way, let's make a mental note of these markings. They're very clear.

talks.objective: Look for clues to track Raptor

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hmm... a strip of cloth with Anemo markings on.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Looking at the design and the way it's woven, there's a good chance it came from a wind glider.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Outriders have to be textile experts now!? It's a harder job than Paimon thought.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: If this really belongs to Raptor, it must mean his wind glider is broken.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Thank goodness, the Knights of Favonius have arrived! The hilichurls won't dare pursue me any longer...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I can't believe it but... the hilichurls attacked our carts. Luckily I outran them.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hilichurls? But I thought the Knights of Favonius had cleared out most of the hilichurl camps around these parts?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: It's a small camp not too far from the village. The route I take on my delivery runs ensures I steer clear of it.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: But today... some crazy fellow suddenly fell out of the sky and landed right in the camp!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now who does that remind me of...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: It really riled them up. They chased the funny-looking fellow as he fled, which brought them out into the open.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I managed to get away, but they smashed my fruit carts to smithereens. I don't know what I'm gonna do when the merchant caravan gets here tomorrow—

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...Funny-looking? In what way?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: He was holding onto something. Must've been heavy, because he couldn't glide in a straight line to save his life... Maybe that's why he fell.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Honestly, people like that shouldn't be allowed in the skies. It doesn't take a genius to know you're not supposed to carry heavy objects while gliding! I'm gonna report that idiot and make sure he gets his license revoked!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Heavy object... The artifact? This could well be our guy.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Tell me, did you see which way he went?

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: I managed to catch a glimpse as I ran from the hilichurls. I think he went... that way.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Seems like a strong lead. {NICKNAME}, on with the chase!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, and don't worry — as soon as I get back I'll tell the Knights to mop up the rest of the hilichurls as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, look where we are...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are no more elemental markings ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: The elemental power on the artifact must have worn off.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Raptor must have realized the markings would give away his position, and sent his minions to slow us down.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That way, when the effect wears off, he can make his escape.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: He won't get away with this! After him!

talks.objective: The direction of Raptor
Additional

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It appears that the elemental markings point this way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Well... D'you think he ran off ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: There's only one way to find out!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #C'mon {NICKNAME}, we should keep following the markings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, what's that? Looks like something's going on up ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It sounds like there's a battle going on — could that be Raptor?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Quick, let's keep going!

talks.objective: Additional

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: If you're quick, you might be able to catch up with those weirdos.
